env.userData: $TMPDIR/ud-p2-places (fresh at the start; the same userData as the interactive part of run.json's steps, which ran first on it)
env.build: main at 7a04adf (was ca6394b before the 2026-09-26 rewrite) + the uncommitted rev 6 phase 2 working tree, with this run's fixes (see result.md)
env.note: NOT deterministic: every part asks the model (gpt-5.4-mini) or the image model (gpt-image-1-mini), New game and Create roll random land seeds, and the golem/pack positions of part C are this land's. Driven interactively in these chunks, one cdp-drive call each; recorded here in order so the flow can be followed. {note} entries are comments (cdp-drive ignores them). Helpers are the same read-only helpers as run.json.

model: openai gpt-5.4-mini (text) and gpt-image-1-mini (pictures), Settings -> Model default on a fresh userData, key from .env

actions.note: A. Built-in world (New game on aether-land 1.3.0, as in run.json up to Play). Tweak -> Add a place, one model call each (plus repairs). Result: p1 side '青苔石階路' (2 calls), p2 dungeon '舊礦道' (3 calls); run.json replays these two stored programs without the model.

actions.type: 東邊一段長滿青苔的舊石階小路，有一位看守的老人、一個寶箱，盡頭是一座小祠

actions.eval: (async()=>{const S=await import("/state/index.ts"); for(let i=0;i<240;i++){const p=S.useLandStore.getState().progress?.places??[]; if(p.length>0) return {ms:Date.now()-window.__e2e.t0, places:p.map(x=>({id:x.id,kind:x.kind,title:x.title,cx:x.cx,cz:x.cz}))}; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));} return 'timeout'})()

(()=>{const i=document.querySelector("[data-layer=tweak] input"); const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,"value").set; set.call(i,""); i.dispatchEvent(new Event("input",{bubbles:true})); i.focus(); return i.value})()

actions.type: 南邊一座舊礦坑的地下通道，住著一位迷路的礦工，角落有一個寶箱

actions.eval: (async()=>{const S=await import("/state/index.ts"); for(let i=0;i<240;i++){const p=S.useLandStore.getState().progress?.places??[]; if(p.length>1) return {ms:Date.now()-window.__e2e.t0}; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));} return 'timeout'})()

actions.note: B. Create a world with fights = gun (from the title: ← 主頁 first when in Play). Look picture 1 chosen; the story came back with 4 chapters (e3 climb, e4 maze).

(async()=>{for(let i=0;i<960;i++){const t=document.body.innerText; if(/因果/.test(t)&&/背包/.test(t)&&!t.includes('建立遊戲')){window.__e2e.playAt=Date.now(); return {buildMs:window.__e2e.playAt-window.__e2e.build0, wordsToLandMs: window.__e2e.playAt-window.__e2e.t0};} await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));} return document.body.innerText.slice(0,800)})()

(async()=>{const S=await import('/state/index.ts'); const a=S.useSessionStore.getState().activeInstance; const r=S.useWorldStore.getState().gameplayRules; return {cartridge: a.instance.save.cartridge, look: a.cartridge.manifest.files?.find(f=>f.path==='assets/look.png') ?? null, combat: r?.combat ?? null, weapons: r?.weapons?.map(w=>({id:w.id,name:w.name,damage:w.damage,range:w.range,cooldownMs:w.cooldownMs})) ?? null, story: a.cartridge.story?.episodes.map(e=>({id:e.id,kind:e.kind,cx:e.cx,cz:e.cz,title:e.title})), state: await __e2e.state()}})()

actions.note: C. Safe home: stand 1 tile inside home's south border 20 s next to golem wild_0_1_1, step out (it chases and strikes), step back (it stops at the border and walks home), then a second pack on the west border.

D. Combat in a side place: Tweak -> Add a place (1 model call, 3 monsters), enter, fire. f3 is the attempt from behind the wall at x 36 (every shot 'empty': the wall stands in the line of fire); f6 fires from x 46 with F, f7 with clicks and the pad's X.
